title: Battle of Port Walthall Junction
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Port Walthall Junction", at revision 1370272143, opens: "The Battle of Port Walthall Junction was fought May 6–7, 1864, between Union and Confederate forces during the Bermuda Hundred Campaign of the American Civil War. Although initially successful, the Confederates were eventually defeated, allowing Union forces to cut a railroad. The Port Walthall Junction on the Richmond-Petersburg Railroad connected with the spur to Port Walthall." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q855628, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1864 battle". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
regionNote: Lane written by the Wikidata import (derived from its own point): this event points at no place record, so the timeline has nothing else to go on.
